source: Two different hoteliers, one per access code (H01, H02); each gave all 60 of their answers themselves in the Space krimits/hotelier-blind-eval; none was given by the owner (the owner's own test used the code H03 and was deleted before the collection); no AI tool was used, as far as the owner knows. As the owner reported on 11 November 2026.
digest: SHA-256 of the lines `<path> <SHA-256 of the file>`, one per rating file, sorted by path
rating_files_kept: in the private dataset and the owner's export, not in this repository: the hoteliers were told their answers are kept in a private dataset (owner's decision, 11 November 2026)
